title: Expert Brain Situation
description:
The level between a capability and its objects. A situation exists so the compiler loads five objects instead of forty. Lives in situations/ INSIDE the capability folder that owns it.

Crucially it carries an EXPLICIT binding to Layer 2 — `matches.l2_situation_types` must name types the pipeline actually emits, otherwise the registry lookup silently misses and the capability never compiles. Silently: nothing errors, nothing logs, the compile just produces nothing.

A situation whose real trigger the pipeline does NOT emit yet declares it under `matches.pending_l2_situation_types` instead. That is the situation-level twin of `inference_patterns[].status: needs_signal`, and it exists for the same reason: a second domain arrives before its pack does, and the choice is otherwise between authoring a lie (binding to a type that means something else) and authoring nothing. A pending binding routes nothing today and says exactly what Layer 1 or 2 must emit for it to start routing. At least one of the two lists must be non-empty.

A situation may serve capabilities beyond its owner; list them in `also_serves`. Ownership decides where the file lives, not who may use it.

id.description: <domain>.sit.<snake_name>. Flat namespace across the domain, because a situation is looked up by Layer 2 type and not by path.

owner_capability.description: The capability whose folder holds this file. validate.py checks it against the path.

matches.description: The join to Layer 2. Authored, so it is testable — a test asserts every emitted L2 type resolves to at least one capability.

l2_situation_types.description: Validated against vocabulary substrate.l2_situation_types. Naming a type outside it is an ERROR, because it can never be looked up.

pending_l2_situation_types.description: Types this situation's real trigger needs, that no shipped pack emits yet. Routes nothing today; index.py ignores it and backlog.py reports it. Naming a type here that the pipeline ALREADY emits is an error — it belongs in l2_situation_types.

nearest_today.description: The closest type the pipeline does emit, when one exists. Names the compromise explicitly rather than letting a reader assume the binding above is exact.

when.description: Optional extra narrowing on top of the type match, in the engine's grammar.

also_serves.description: Capability ids beyond the owner that this situation routes into. Enterprise Deal is owned by buying_committee_analysis and also serves legal_review, procurement and deal_review — one file, many consumers, resolved into a set by index.py.

objects.description: The load-set. The whole point of this file: five objects, not forty.

never_load.description: Explicitly excluded even if a capability lists them as required — e.g. Buying Committee in a self-serve B2C flow.

priority_bp.description: Relative business importance of this situation class. Advisory input to Layer 4's Priority Unit; Layer 3 never ranks.

signals_of_progress.description: Observation kinds that indicate this situation is resolving. Feeds Layer 5 success_events.
